newsitem.title: LATVIA: TRASTA SAYS WORKS ON SEVERAL PUBLIC ISSUES.
newsitem.headline: TRASTA SAYS WORKS ON SEVERAL PUBLIC ISSUES.

text.p: Trasta Bank, Latvia's 14th largest bank, said on Tuesday that it is working on arranging a number of public share issues by companies.
One, for Mangali Shipyard, will be completed this year, the bank said.
"The Mangali issue will be this year and is one of several that Trasta is currently working on," Roberts Idelsons, head of the securities department at the Trasta Bank, told Reuters.
Mangali Shipyard said earlier that it plans a public issue of 200,000 shares with Trasta as arranger and an agreement could be signed later this week.
Trasta Bank earlier said that arranging public share issues would become one its specialities.
The bank earlier this summer placed the Balta insurance company's public issue through an auction.
